items.claim: Stephen Aspel's takedown defense has improved significantly.
items.quote: Stephen Aspel's takedown defense has gotten a lot better.

items.claim: Guerme Pat is lacking power in his striking.
items.quote: Very confident with his striking to walk people down but lacking the power.

items.claim: Billy Ray Golf hasn't fought in over a year.
items.quote: We haven't seen him fight in over a year.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a massive reach advantage over Billy Ray Golf.
items.quote: Tai Miller is going to be landing a lot of straight punches on Billy Ray Golf with that massive reach advantage.

items.claim: Billy Ray Golf has never been flatline knocked out before and has good durability.
items.quote: He's never actually been like flatline KO'ed before and he seems to have pretty good durability.
